newsitem.title: USA: Pro-Fac unit plans sauerkraut company.
newsitem.headline: Pro-Fac unit plans sauerkraut company.

text.p: Curtice Burns Foods, a unit of Pro-Fac Cooperative, and Flanagan Brothers Inc said Friday they have signed a letter of intent to merge their sauerkraut production assets into a new company.
Curtice Burns currently has sauerkraut operations in New York, while Flanagan, which is based in Bear Creek Wisc., has operations in Wisconsin and New York.
The companies said they will split ownership in the new company, which is yet to be named. The new entity will operate as a cooperative and be incorporated in New York state, they said.
Curtice Burns produces the Silver Floos sauerkraut brand while Flanagan Bros. produces the Krrrrisp Kraut brand.
The companies said they expect to complete the transaction by the ened of June, subject to due diligence, board approval and filing requirements of the Federal Trade Commission.
